name: Borgstedt (Germany)
description: Green field with a white wavy bend sinister, charged in the upper hoist with a yellow staff with rings and in the lower fly with a yellow wheel, the figures of the municipal arms of Borgstedt.
history: Municipal flag of Borgstedt; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: staff with rings from the arms
